t: This place is linked to Refuge, a British charity that supports women and children experiencing domestic violence. It was founded in 1971 by Erin Pizzey, who set it up as Chiswick Women's Aid. It's described as the world's first and largest domestic violence shelter. Today Refuge runs a national network of specialist services, including emergency accommodation, outreach and child support workers. It also runs the Freephone 24-Hour National Domestic Abuse Helpline.
